title: Freya and the Summer
author: August Voss
blurb: Ines Amberdale, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
